name: Ro60-0175
summary: Ro60-0175, or Ro-600175, also known as (S)-5-fluoro-6-chloro-α-methylisotryptamine ((S)-5-F-6-Cl-isoAMT), is a serotonin 5-HT2 receptor agonist of the isotryptamine family developed by Hoffmann–La Roche, which has applications in scientific research. It is the enantiopure (S)- isomer of the 5-fluoro and 6-chloro derivative of α-methylisotryptamine (isoAMT).

pharmacology.text: Ro60-0175, or Ro-600175, also known as (S)-5-fluoro-6-chloro-α-methylisotryptamine ((S)-5-F-6-Cl-isoAMT), is a serotonin 5-HT2 receptor agonist of the isotryptamine family developed by Hoffmann–La Roche, which has applications in scientific research. The drug has been found to inhibit dopaminergic signaling in the mesolimbic pathway.

fact.en: Ro60-0175 is an isotryptamine: its side chain is attached at a different point on the indole ring than in ordinary tryptamines such as DMT.
fact.zh: Ro60-0175 屬於異色胺：它的側鏈接在吲哚環上不同的位置，和 DMT 等一般色胺不同。
fact.zhHans: Ro60-0175 属于异色胺：它的侧链接在吲哚环上不同的位置，和 DMT 等一般色胺不同。
